headline: October Home Inspections in Milford
subhead: Essential fall checkups to prioritize before closing on your shoreline home.
caption: When touring homes in Milford this October, the cooling weather gives you an advantage during the inspection phase. Autumn is the right time to evaluate heating systems under actual working conditions rather than relying on a brief test run. Ask your inspector to thoroughly review the furnace or boiler, check chimney flues, and inspect window caulking and seals for drafts. Near the shoreline, fall winds and rain also make it easier to identify exterior drainage concerns, gutter blockages, and roof wear before winter arrives. Understanding the condition of these major components helps you budget accurately and make informed decisions on your offer. If you are planning to shop for a home in Milford this fall, send a message to discuss your next steps.
